stem: How can the reader tell that this is a narrative poem?

options.label: A
options.text: The poem contains words that appeal to the senses.

options.label: B
options.text: The speaker of the poem shares his or her feelings.

options.label: C
options.text: The poem has lines that make the reader laugh.

options.label: D
options.text: The events described in the poem tell a story.
